description: Compares two control voltages and reports the result eight ways

params.text: Adds a fixed voltage to B, over -10V to 10V; with the B input unpatched it sets B outright

inputs.text: One of the two voltages being compared
One of the two voltages being compared, before the offset knob is added to it

outputs.text: Whichever of A and B is the larger at each moment
Whichever of A and B is the smaller at each moment
A held inside the range -B to B, so anything beyond that range is flattened to the edge
The part of A that lies beyond the range -B to B, and 0V while A is inside it; adding this to the clipped output gives A back
High while A is outside the range -B to B
High while A is inside the range -B to B
High while the A voltage is greater than the B voltage
High while the A voltage is less than the B voltage
